relationships.description: Governed by the NEXT F Changelog Standard.

validationRules.description: Every published Changelog release version is unique.
version must be an exact semantic version and never a floating latest alias.
Unknown historical release dates remain null rather than being guessed.
sourceVersion must be the immediately preceding coordinated release when that predecessor is known; targetVersion equals version.
Known incomplete historical records are explicitly marked incomplete with a reason.
Affected release summaries are derived only from explicit affected Registry IDs.
Changelog compatibility summaries may reference but never override Compatibility Center.
